National Emergency Child Care Network You will be deployed to help families with emergency child care. Asheville, NC Sign up here
United Way of Asheville and Buncombe County Volunteers to help with evolving daily operations of our offices. Asheville, NC Sign up here
Energy Savers Network Volunteers join our team at client homes to complete energy efficiency repairs and upgrades, from swapping in LED light bulbs to insulating attic hatches and more. No prior experience necessary. Asheville, NC and surrounding areas Sign up here
Manna Foodbank Volunteers gather to sort and pack the food donations that come through our doors. Mills River, NC Sign up here
BeLoved Asheville Distribution center help. Asheville, NC Sign up here

Heart with Hands Assist with packing boxes with water, hygiene kits, cleaning supplies, baby supplies, cat and dog food. Swannoanoa, NC Sign up here
Lutheran Services Carolinas Support long-term relief and recovery efforts. Salisbury, NC Sign up here
Baptist on Mission Skilled and unskilled volunteers to help with this first rebuild phase which will get people back into their home and make it safe, sanitary and functional (not finished) before the worst of winter. Volunteers will be needed for the next few years to help people finish their homes. 7 disaster rebuild locations in WNC Sign up here
Second Harvest Food Bank of Northwest NC Food Sorting and Community Meals programs, directly helping provide much-needed food and resources to the communities affected by Helene. ongoing sign up in: Alamance, Alexander, Alleghany, Ashe, Caldwell, Caswell, Davidson, Davie, Forsyth, Guilford, Iredell, Randolph, Rockingham, Stokes, Surry, Watauga, Wilkes, Yadkin Sign up here

Lost Province Center for Cultural Art/Old Lansing School Organizing, sorting, receiving, traffic, and personal shopping. Lansing, NC Sign up here
Compassion in Action Load/unload, sort, inventory, stock North Wilkesboro, NC Sign up here
Avery County Donation and Volunteer Coordination Various opportunities for skilled volunteers. Newland, NC Sign up here

Mitchell County Distribution Center Mitchell County Distribution Center located at Bowman Middle School Bakersville, NC Contact Katie Vogel 828-467-8783
The Sanctuary at Red Bell Run Farm This is a hay and feed bank for all of WNC. Very active during Helene Columbus, NC Contact Mary Adams 863-956-7571
Reconcilation House Food Pantry They have become the primary post-storm distribution site for Yancey, and have been a trusted and respected community support for decades addressing food insecurity, heating and rent assistance, among other supports. They may have opportunities on Tuesday as we Burnsville, NC Sign up here
